reason: The plugin’s primary user-facing purpose is to provide a vision-style input workflow for a text-only LLM by converting images into ASCII text and using that as model input, which aligns with media tooling for image-to-text processing.

summaries.zh: 该插件为 DeepSeek Harness 提供文本方式的图像处理能力：将输入图片转换为 ASCII 艺术文本后再交由文本模型进行内容判断。
summaries.en: This plugin adds a text-based image handling path for DeepSeek Harness by converting input images into ASCII art text and sending it to a text-only LLM for content interpretation.

capabilities: Converts input images into ASCII-art text
Feeds converted image text into a text-only LLM for content inference
